rationale: Independent reading: EO 9067 (7 FR 1407-1409, [No. 9067]) six paragraphs on transfers of personnel to war agencies. Held EO 9243 (7 FR 7213) para. 3: 'Executive Order No. 8973 ... and Executive Order No. 9067 of February 20, 1942, are hereby revoked, effective on the fifteenth day following the date of this order', proviso preserves reemployment rights already acquired, not the order. Named whole revocation. I agree: NO.
